scripts.generate: bun --cwd platform run distribute && bun --cwd apps/files run gen && bun --cwd apps/mail run gen
scripts.test: bun --cwd platform test && bun --cwd apps/files test && bun --cwd apps/mail test && bun test scripts
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd platform run typecheck && bun --cwd apps/files run typecheck && bun --cwd apps/mail run typecheck && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: bun run generate && bun run test && bun run typecheck
